newsitem.title: UK: EMAP drops as report highlights departure.
newsitem.headline: EMAP drops as report highlights departure.

text.p: Shares in media group EMAP Plc dropped on Tuesday as a report in the Independent newspaper highlighed another senior manager leaving the company, prompting further profit-taking in the stock, dealers said.
EMAP shares were down 4-1/2p at 745, after hitting a day's low of 744p -- its lowest since early January. Volume in the stock was a modest 90,032 shares.

The Independent said John Thater, managing director of EMAP media, had quit, adding to worries over the company's management after last month's news that managing director David Arculus had quit to join United News & Media.
EMAP confirmed the departure but no-one at the company was immediately available for further comment.

Credit Lyonnais Laing analyst Nick Ward said he had cut the stock to "hold" from "buy," pointing out that Arculus's departure was "obviously disapointing" and that the stock had had a good run in recent months.
From below 400p in early March last year, EMAP shares more than doubled to reach a record 835p last month.
